subject: Maths
title: Translation
subtitle: Transformations · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can translate shapes using a column vector.

key_vocab.definition: A translation slides a shape without rotating or flipping it. It is described by a column vector that shows the horizontal and vertical movement.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can translate shapes using a column vector.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: translation -- A translation slides a shape without rotating or flipping it. It is described by a column vector that shows the horizontal and vertical movement.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Add the column vector to each vertex: new x = x + horizontal, new y = y + vertical.
(x, y) + (a, b) = (x+a, y+b)
Every point moves by the same vector

Key examples:
  ✓ Vector (3, 2) means 3 right and 2 up  (positive values)
  ✓ Vector (-2, -4) means 2 left and 4 down  (negative values)
  ✓ (5, 1) translated by (3, -2) gives (8, -1)  (add the vector)
  ✗ Vector (3, 2) means 3 up and 2 right  (top is horizontal, bottom is vertical)
  ✗ Translation changes the size of the shape  (shape and size are preserved)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – positive translation
  Translate (2, 3) by vector (4, 1).
  Add horizontal: 2 + 4 = 6
  Add vertical: 3 + 1 = 4
  Image: (6, 4)
  (6, 4)
  (Simply add the vector components to the coordinates.)

Example 2 – negative components
  Translate (5, 7) by vector (-3, -2).
  Horizontal: 5 + (-3) = 2
  Vertical: 7 + (-2) = 5
  Image: (2, 5)
  (2, 5)
  (Negative values mean left and down.)

sections.title: Positive translations
sections.content:
Translate each point by the given vector.

(a) (1, 2) by (3, 4)
(b) (0, 5) by (2, 1)
(c) (3, 0) by (5, 3)
(d) (4, 4) by (1, 2)

sections.title: Finding the vector
sections.content:
Find the translation vector from A to B.

(a) A(2, 3) to B(5, 7)
(b) A(6, 4) to B(2, 1)
(c) A(-1, 3) to B(4, -2)
(d) A(0, 0) to B(-3, 5)

sections.title: Mixed translation problems
sections.content:
Solve each problem.

(a) (3, 5) by (-1, -3)
(b) Image is (7, 2), vector was (4, -3). Original?
(c) Translate (0, 0) by (a, b) then by (-a, -b). Final position?
(d) (2, 1) translated to (5, 4). Then (5, 4) to (8, 7). Combined vector?
(e) (4, -2) by (3, 5) then by (-1, -2). Final?

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Translation by (3, -2) means 3 right and 2 down
✗ The top of the vector is the vertical shift
✓ Translation preserves shape, size, and orientation
✗ Translating by (0, 0) moves the shape to the origin
✓ Vector from A to B = B coordinates minus A coordinates
